params.description: Ordered params: empty; this slot has no effect.
Ordered params: Drive (dimensionless input gain before tanh); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).
Ordered params: Samples (delay in audio sample frames, not ms; truncated after runtime ring-safe clamping); Feedback (linear delayed-signal gain into the ring); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Rate Hz (internal sine modulation cycles/second, not period_ms); Depth (sample frames added as depth*(0.5+0.5*sin(phase)) to an 11 ms base delay, runtime ring-safe clamped); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Room (dimensionless Freeverb control, comb feedback=0.7+0.28*Room); Damping (dimensionless control, one-pole previous-state coefficient=0.4*Damping); Wet (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet).

Ordered params: Threshold (positive linear peak amplitude, not dB); Ratio (dimensionless compression ratio, gain=(Threshold/envelope)^(1-1/Ratio) above threshold); Attack and Release (per-sample previous-envelope coefficients, not durations: envelope=(1-c)*peak+c*previous, c chosen on rising/falling peak; 0 immediate, values nearer 1 slower; for 0<c<1, time constant seconds=-1/(sample_rate*ln(c))); Makeup (linear output gain, not dB).

Ordered params: Lowpass Hz then Highpass Hz (cutoff frequencies, not coefficients; nonpositive disables that edge, positive values round to integer Hz and clamp to [1,sample_rate/2-1]; runtime generates FIR taps); FIR Slope (integer percent 1..100, 100 = the sharpest full-window response; an omitted base_value defaults to 100 while supplied modulation fields are preserved; explicit values follow the decoder's pre-narrowing integer grammar want_int(1, 100) - fractional spellings the schema's integer type accepts, such as 50.0, still fail the decoder).

fir_bands.description: FIR bandpass band count. Omitted means the legacy single band. Present only when the count exceeds 1; bands 1..count-1 may omit their fir_bandN objects, and an absent active-band object decodes the neutral defaults (gain 1.0, slope 100). fir_band0_gain encodes when band 0's gain binding is non-default for its form: with fir_bands stated the default is the neutral 1.0; in the count-1 legacy form any authored state encodes (the zeroed block is not producible and refuses on decode).

params.description: Ordered params: the plain FIR's legacy Lowpass Hz, Highpass Hz and FIR Slope bindings, carried for format compatibility.  This type's audible bands live in fir_bandN: every band stores Center/Spread/Gain/Slope and the coefficient staging derives each band's edges, so the legacy scalars are not user-visible and their values do not affect the sound.

fir_bands.description: Multi-band FIR band count.  Omitted means the single band.  Present only when the count exceeds 1; bands beyond an active band's fir_bandN object decode the neutral defaults (center 0, spread 0, gain 1, slope 100), so an unconfigured band contributes nothing.

params.description: Ordered params: Rate Hz (carrier sine cycles/second, phase-continuous across steps); Mix (dry/wet fraction, 0 dry, 1 wet; out = mix(in, in*carrier, mix)).

routing.description: v3 routing flags: out holds one flag per slot (0 disconnected, 1 feeds the next occupied slot, 2 feeds the output; at most one slot holds 2), in marks the input node feeding slot 0; the out array length must equal the effects array length.

audio_next.description: Explicit outgoing successors for payload slots 0..3 then Input: 0 absent, 1..4 slot+1, 5 Output. Unused/none source entries must be zero; destinations must name real slots or Output. All fragments must be acyclic with unique incoming and outgoing endpoints. Only a complete Input-to-Output path plays; incomplete paths bypass dry. All four retained payloads reserve existing budgets.

title: Portable effects chain
description: Self-contained retained effects collection. v1 is implicit serial order; v2 requires explicit audio_next topology, preserving detached effects and layout (both stay accepted legacy inputs); v3 carries routing flags instead, with the out array length matching the effects array length.  LFO ids are one-based array identities, not hashes; slot ids are zero-based and include none slots.  Required LFO wave and period_ms have no valid omitted default; other omitted scalar fields default to zero, add, or none (enabled defaults to false), not the editor's new-effect presets.  Layout identities must be unique and reference a real effect or existing LFO.  Unconnected represented LFOs are retained.  Master paste adopts a channel chain onto the master chain, which resolves its MIDI sources from channel index 0.  FIR coefficients and audio state are generated at runtime.  Documents must fit 65535 UTF-8 bytes and 8192 parser tokens, and the resulting complete bank must fit descriptor, graph, modulation and effect-state budgets.  Schema conformance alone cannot express full runtime validation: the production decoder and destination-bank validation must also accept the document.  Unknown or duplicate keys refuse.  No custom titles.

fir_band.description: One extra FIR bandpass band: lowpass and highpass cutoff Hz bindings (nonpositive lowpass disables the band), linear gain binding (default 1, clamped to [0,1] at staging) and integer-percent slope binding (default 100).

fir_multiband_band.description: One Multi-band FIR band: center and spread cutoff Hz bindings (the coefficient staging derives the band's edges, highpass = center - spread/2 and lowpass = center + spread/2; a band with nonpositive spread or nonpositive center contributes nothing), linear gain binding (default 1, clamped to [0,1] at staging) and integer-percent slope binding (default 100).
